description: Zig HTTP/1.1 server on the zix.Http1 raw engine, .URING dispatch: per-worker SO_REUSEPORT multishot accept plus io_uring loop, per-worker /json cache, every route through the parser and comptime Router (pipeline responses coalesce via the staged send sink), gzip on Accept-Encoding, prewarmed static cache with .br/.gz negotiation. Dual listener (config.tls_port): cleartext 8080 plus https TLS 1.3 on 8081, one process.
